figures.finding: The CNMI's Public Law 13-29 (2002) set up a Commonwealth Film, Video and Media Office within the Marianas Visitors Authority, collecting all film permit fees under a one-stop single permit to fund itself; the act provides a permit regime, not a rebate or fund.

value.office: Northern Mariana Islands Film Office, within the Marianas Visitors Authority
value.fees: one-stop single permit; fees fund the office

sources.said: There is established within the Marianas Visitors Authority (MVA), a Commonwealth Film, Video and Media Office, to be referred to as the "Northern Mariana Islands Film Office" ("film office"). … All film/media permit fees in the Commonwealth will be collected by the film office under a one-stop, single permit framework. All film/media permit fees collected by the film office will be solely used to fund the operations of the film office.
